rules.name: Create case from RFQ email
rules.trigger: New email to sales@ / purchasing@ classified as RFQ
rules.action: Create case, link email & files, extract draft lines (AI)
rules.stop: Duplicate (same customer ref / attachment hash) → link instead

rules.name: RFQ acknowledgement
rules.action: Send branded acknowledgement
rules.approval: Template wording, recipients & trigger approved by Karim Balbaa 10 Nov
rules.stop: Already acknowledged in thread · internal sender · customer rule “no auto-ack”

rules.name: Website quick-quote form
rules.action: Create draft case + contact (AI extraction of items)
rules.retry: Form also emails the sales mailbox as fallback

rules.name: Assign owner
rules.action: Owner + backup by customer, then category rules
rules.approval: Owner can override (logged with a handover note)

rules.name: After-hours & weekend RFQ
rules.trigger: Urgent RFQ outside Sun–Thu 08:00–17:00 or vessel ETA < 24 h
rules.action: Alert the on-duty person by WhatsApp / SMS; senior call list next
rules.retry: Escalate to the backup, then senior contacts, after 15 min

rules.name: Match supplier reply
rules.action: Match by RFQ ref / thread / sender; extract offer lines (AI)
rules.approval: Auto ≥ 0.85, review below · low confidence never overwrites approved values

rules.name: Save new supplier & prices
rules.action: Create supplier (status New), save dated product prices

rules.name: Agency pricelist pricing
rules.trigger: Line matches an agency brand (Vecom, Lalizas, Lukoil, Marichem…)
rules.action: Price instantly from the principal's pricelist & own stock; no supplier RFQ needed
rules.approval: Pricelist versions approved by Karim Balbaa

rules.name: Own-stock check
rules.action: Show available stock (Cairo / Alexandria) and reserve on selection

rules.name: Supplier reminder
rules.trigger: Supplier RFQ due in 2 h with no reply
rules.action: Send pre-approved follow-up; 2nd reminder after 24 h
rules.stop: Reply, decline, case closed, line cancelled

rules.name: Escalate no response
rules.action: Escalate to owner + daily briefing; status No response

rules.name: Offer deviation check
rules.action: Compare to request: brand, part, qty, unit, pack, spec, validity, lead time vs ETA (AI + rules)
rules.approval: Technical equivalence is a human decision

rules.name: Correction request draft
rules.action: Draft supplier clarification without client identity

rules.name: Margin & FX check
rules.trigger: Offer selected / FX changed / cost changed
rules.action: Recalculate landed cost, margin and flags

rules.name: Customer follow-up
rules.trigger: Quote submitted, no response in 3 days
rules.action: Internal reminder; customer draft only if the account allows

rules.name: Customer PO check
rules.action: Match PO to quote version & lines (AI extraction + rules)

rules.name: ETA change
rules.action: Move delivery tasks, transport booking and supplier pickup; alert owner

rules.name: E-invoice submission
rules.action: Sign and submit to the Egyptian Tax Authority; store UUID and status
rules.retry: Idempotent by invoice number; 3 retries, then exception

rules.name: Collections reminder
rules.trigger: Invoice overdue / installment due in 3 days
rules.action: Internal reminder + collection draft

rules.name: Held stores storage charge
rules.trigger: Stores held for a vessel > 14 days
rules.action: Notify owner & draft customer note; start the storage charge

rules.name: Daily briefing
rules.action: Urgent work, pending replies, approvals, delivery risks, overdue payments
